reviews.title: It's like new and saved me some money. Great feeling mouse and I would buy it again
reviews.comment:
Was a little skeptical cause of the bad reviews so I went in with the plan to just send it back within the 90 day return window. 
It's been almost 2 weeks now and everything's been working exactly like it's supposed to. The box came with everything you'd get from buying it new (instruction manual, original cord, wireless receiver, and even some mouse grips and stickers) except the actual box for the product which is no big deal. There is a tiny scratch on the bottom of the mouse but it doesn't ruin the functionality and it's on the bottom so I don't see it 99% of the time anyways. The battery has been fully depleted (about 3 days a charge) and charged twice now with no issues and no stuttering or loss of input.
As for the mouse itself, it's very high quality. Before this I had the Gpro X Superlight 2 and it's very similar in weight and shape so switching to it took no time. The clicks are satisfying, the default skates are pretty smooth, the scroll wheel is very tactical feeling (like you can feel the individual scrolls), and the software is pretty intuitive although I wish they would do a web based version but it is what it is.
reviews.author: Dallas Boano

reviews.title: Amazing mouse
reviews.comment: This mouse is amazing, I had a Logitech g pro x super light and it broke out of nowhere so I ordered this and it exceeded my expectations, great quality, easy connectivity, amazing value for money and a pretty good battery life.

reviews.title: Nice mouse for gaming
reviews.comment: Unsure what the other reviews are, I guess I didn’t get a defective product. This is quite a good mouse, didn’t come in the original box but worth it for a bit cheaper. Still going strong months later. That said, the battery is a bit lower since I run it at higher DPI for gaming, so I switched to Logitech productivity mouse for daily work and reserve this mouse just for gaming
